statusDefinitions.implemented: Present in repository and usable for the described scope; tests or runtime evidence should still be checked.
statusDefinitions.partial: Implemented in a limited scope with documented constraints.

features.name: JSON/JSONL submission validation and conflict-aware staging
features.notes: Shared importer, normalizer, and conflict-aware staging run in the browser bundle; provenance retained; dry-run only, no persistence or authorization.

features.name: Shared query, staging, and review modules bundled for static portal
features.notes: Pages build bundles repository modules without a runtime server; build fails on invalid corpus.

features.name: Grouped candidate review summaries and snapshot-bound decision validation
features.notes: Groups staging statuses and validates decision shape, candidate fingerprint, and supplied corpus snapshot ID; reviewer identity is not authenticated and decisions are not persisted.

features.name: Static GitHub Pages landing and documentation site
features.notes: Workflow is configured; public deployment must be verified after merge to main and Pages settings.

features.name: Browser portal for graph search, relationships, source/evidence, submission preview, and endpoint registry
features.notes: Read-only static client; lexical search, shared bounded traversal, shared JSON/JSONL staging, and grouped review classifications.
